memo: Opened Basic Macros dialog (alt+F11). Next: select Module1 under My Macros>Standard, click Edit to open Basic IDE, paste macro: for each page in oDoc.DrawPages and oDoc.MasterPages, for each shape, if InStr(shape.String,"<number>")>0 or supportsService("com.sun.star.presentation.SlideNumberShape") then shape.CharColor=RGB(255,0,0); then F5, then ctrl+s in Impress (Keep format).
